meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily skin aur excess oil control ke liye ₹500 ke andar kai acche aur budget-friendly options available hain. Face wash chunte waqt aise ingredients dekhein jo extra oil ko saaf karein par skin ko bilkul dry na karein (jaise **Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Green Tea, ya Tea Tree**).

₹500 ke andar kuch top-rated face washes:

---

### 1. Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash

* **Price:** Around ₹300 - ₹350 (100ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea, Glycolic Acid
* **Kyun accha hai:** Yeh oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye sabse popular options mein se ek hai. Green tea skin ke excess oil ko control karne mein madad karti hai aur glycolic acid pores ko deep clean karta hai.

### 2. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser

* **Price:** Around ₹299 (100ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc
* **Kyun accha hai:** Agar aapko oily skin ke sath-sath pimples ya blackheads ki problem bhi hoti hai, toh yeh face wash pores ke andar jaakar sebum aur dirt ko saaf karta hai.

### 3. Dot & Key CICA Calming Blemish Clearing Gel Face Wash

* **Price:** Around ₹200 - ₹250 (100ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid, Green Tea, Cica
* **Kyun accha hai:** Yeh ek gentle gel-based cleanser hai jo oily skin ko bina dry kiye extra oil aur acne-causing bacteria ko control karta hai. Cica skin ko soothe (calm) karne mein bhi help karta hai.

### 4. Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Face Wash

* **Price:** Around ₹180 - ₹275 (150ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Pro-Vitamin B5, Chamomile
* **Kyun accha hai:** Agar aapki oily skin sensitive bhi hai aur aapko harsh chemicals ya fragrance se allergy hoti hai, toh yeh ek non-stripping aur soap-free mild option hai.

### 5. The Derma Co. 1% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash

* **Price:** Around ₹299 (100ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid, Witch Hazel
* **Kyun accha hai:** Yeh face wash skin ke excess sebum production ko balance karta hai aur pores ko tighten karne mein help karta hai.

---

> **Tip:** Din mein **2 baar** se zyada face wash na karein, warna skin dry ho kar aur zyada oil produce karne lag sakti hai. Face wash ke baad ek lightweight, oil-free moisturizer zaroor use karein!
